"""Spot-check read: runs 6 (electron, n=+3.2e12) and 7 (hole, n=-1.2e12).

Onset + FFT tone content per sdh-spot-check Verify. Raw first, then the read.
"""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import hera.analysis as A
from hera.analysis import (open_run, summarize_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft,
                           luttinger_frequency, resolve_channels, current_channel,
                           SdhOnsetError)

BASE = "/home/hera/measurements/zack/20260822-vti-02/data"
SPOTS = ((6, "electron", +3.20e12), (7, "hole", -1.20e12))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 8))
out = {}

for row, (fid, nlabel, nval) in enumerate(SPOTS):
    run = open_run(f"{BASE}/{fid}")
    chans = resolve_channels(run.meta)
    cur = current_channel(chans)
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f"RUN {fid} — {nlabel}, n = {nval:+.3e} cm^-2")
    for c in chans:
        print(f"   {c.col}  cid={c.cid} gain={c.gain} label={c.label} is_current={c.is_current}")

    B = run.col("magnet_field")
    I = run.col(cur.col) / cur.gain
    vch = [c for c in chans if not c.is_current and c.col in run.cols]
    # sr1 is the Rxx channel (device card); sr2/sr3 n.c.
    c1 = [c for c in vch if c.cid in ("sr1", "sr830_1")][0]
    V = run.col(c1.col) / c1.gain
    R = V / I
    order = np.argsort(B)
    B, R, I = B[order], R[order], I[order]
    T = run.col("T_sample")[order]
    print(f"   B {B.min():.3f}..{B.max():.3f} T, N={len(B)}")
    print(f"   I_meas med {np.median(I)*1e9:.3f} nA (ptp {np.ptp(I)*1e9:.3f} nA)")
    print(f"   R: min {np.nanmin(R):.1f}  max {np.nanmax(R):.1f}  at B=0-edge {R[0]:.1f} Ohm")
    print(f"   T_sample {T.min():.3f}..{T.max():.3f} K")
    sens = run.meta.get("measurement_config", {}).get("sr1_sens")
    print(f"   sr1_sens {sens}; R_full_scale = {None if sens is None else sens/np.median(I):.1f} Ohm")
    igt = np.abs(run.col("k_2400_tg_curr")); igb = np.abs(run.col("k_2400_bg_curr"))
    print(f"   |I_tg| max {igt.max()*1e12:.1f} pA, |I_bg| max {igb.max()*1e12:.1f} pA")

    ax = axes[row, 0]
    ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.7)
    ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("R_xx (Ohm)")
    ax.set_title(f"run {fid} raw — {nlabel} n={nval:+.2e}")

    # --- onset ---
    r_fs = None if sens is None else sens / np.median(np.abs(I))
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=r_fs)
        print(on.summary())
        out[fid] = on
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"   SdhOnsetError: {e}")
        out[fid] = None

    # --- FFT over a few cutoffs (stability sweep) ---
    F_L = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(nval)))
    print(f"   F_L = (h/4e)*n = {F_L:.2f} T")
    ax = axes[row, 1]
    for cutoff in (1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0):
        if cutoff >= B.max():
            continue
        try:
            f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(cutoff, B.max()), bg_degree=5)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"   fft cutoff {cutoff}: {e}"); continue
        s = spec[0]
        ax.plot(f, s, lw=0.9, label=f"cut {cutoff} T")
        pk = f[(s > 0) & (f > 2)]
        # top 5 local maxima
        sm = s.copy()
        idx = np.argsort(sm)[::-1]
        picked = []
        for i in idx:
            if f[i] < 2:
                continue
            if all(abs(f[i] - p) > 1.5 for p in picked):
                picked.append(f[i])
            if len(picked) >= 5:
                break
        print(f"   fft cut {cutoff:.1f}->{B.max():.1f} T: top peaks (T) "
              + ", ".join(f"{p:.2f}({p/F_L:.3f}F_L)" for p in sorted(picked, reverse=True)))
    ax.set_xlim(0, max(60, F_L * 1.8)); ax.axvline(F_L, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label="F_L")
    ax.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("|FFT| (log)"); ax.legend(fontsize=7)
    ax.set_title(f"run {fid} FFT stability (bg_degree=5)")

    # --- background-subtracted trace vs 1/B ---
    ax = axes[row, 2]
    m = B > 0.5
    p = np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5)
    ax.plot(1 / B[m], R[m] - np.polyval(p, B[m]), lw=0.7)
    ax.set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax.set_ylabel("dR (Ohm)")
    ax.set_title(f"run {fid} bg-subtracted vs 1/B")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("/home/hera/measurements/zack/20260822-vti-02/hera_scratch/spot67.png", dpi=110)
print("saved spot67.png")

"""Spot-check read: runs 6 (electron, n=+3.2e12) and 7 (hole, n=-1.2e12).

Onset + FFT tone content per sdh-spot-check Verify. Raw first, then the read.
"""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import hera.analysis as A
from hera.analysis import (open_run, summarize_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft,
                           luttinger_frequency, resolve_channels, current_channel,
                           SdhOnsetError)

BASE = "/home/hera/measurements/zack/20260822-vti-02/data"
SPOTS = ((6, "electron", +3.20e12), (7, "hole", -1.20e12))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 8))
out = {}

for row, (fid, nlabel, nval) in enumerate(SPOTS):
    run = open_run(f"{BASE}/{fid}")
    chans = resolve_channels(run.meta)
    cur = current_channel(chans)
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f"RUN {fid} — {nlabel}, n = {nval:+.3e} cm^-2")
    for c in chans:
        print(f"   {c.col}  cid={c.cid} gain={c.gain} label={c.label} is_current={c.is_current}")

    B = run.col("magnet_field")
    I = run.col(cur.col) / cur.gain
    vch = [c for c in chans if not c.is_current and c.col in run.cols]
    # sr1 is the Rxx channel (device card); sr2/sr3 n.c.
    c1 = [c for c in vch if c.cid in ("sr1", "sr830_1")][0]
    V = run.col(c1.col) / c1.gain
    R = V / I
    order = np.argsort(B)
    B, R, I = B[order], R[order], I[order]
    T = run.col("T_sample")[order]
    print(f"   B {B.min():.3f}..{B.max():.3f} T, N={len(B)}")
    print(f"   I_meas med {np.median(I)*1e9:.3f} nA (ptp {np.ptp(I)*1e9:.3f} nA)")
    print(f"   R: min {np.nanmin(R):.1f}  max {np.nanmax(R):.1f}  at B=0-edge {R[0]:.1f} Ohm")
    print(f"   T_sample {T.min():.3f}..{T.max():.3f} K")
    sens = run.meta.get("measurement_config", {}).get("sr1_sens")
    print(f"   sr1_sens {sens}; R_full_scale = {None if sens is None else sens/np.median(I):.1f} Ohm")
    igt = np.abs(run.col("k_2400_tg_curr")); igb = np.abs(run.col("k_2400_bg_curr"))
    print(f"   |I_tg| max {igt.max()*1e12:.1f} pA, |I_bg| max {igb.max()*1e12:.1f} pA")

    ax = axes[row, 0]
    ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.7)
    ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("R_xx (Ohm)")
    ax.set_title(f"run {fid} raw — {nlabel} n={nval:+.2e}")

    # --- onset ---
    r_fs = None if sens is None else sens / np.median(np.abs(I))
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=r_fs)
        print(on.summary())
        out[fid] = on
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"   SdhOnsetError: {e}")
        out[fid] = None

    # --- FFT over a few cutoffs (stability sweep) ---
    F_L = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(nval)))
    print(f"   F_L = (h/4e)*n = {F_L:.2f} T")
    ax = axes[row, 1]
    for cutoff in (1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0):
        if cutoff >= B.max():
            continue
        try:
            f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(cutoff, B.max()), bg_degree=5)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"   fft cutoff {cutoff}: {e}"); continue
        s = spec[0]
        ax.plot(f, s, lw=0.9, label=f"cut {cutoff} T")
        pk = f[(s > 0) & (f > 2)]
        # top 5 local maxima
        sm = s.copy()
        idx = np.argsort(sm)[::-1]
        picked = []
        for i in idx:
            if f[i] < 2:
                continue
            if all(abs(f[i] - p) > 1.5 for p in picked):
                picked.append(f[i])
            if len(picked) >= 5:
                break
        print(f"   fft cut {cutoff:.1f}->{B.max():.1f} T: top peaks (T) "
              + ", ".join(f"{p:.2f}({p/F_L:.3f}F_L)" for p in sorted(picked, reverse=True)))
    ax.set_xlim(0, max(60, F_L * 1.8)); ax.axvline(F_L, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label="F_L")
    ax.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("|FFT| (log)"); ax.legend(fontsize=7)
    ax.set_title(f"run {fid} FFT stability (bg_degree=5)")

    # --- background-subtracted trace vs 1/B ---
    ax = axes[row, 2]
    m = B > 0.5
    p = np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5)
    ax.plot(1 / B[m], R[m] - np.polyval(p, B[m]), lw=0.7)
    ax.set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax.set_ylabel("dR (Ohm)")
    ax.set_title(f"run {fid} bg-subtracted vs 1/B")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("/home/hera/measurements/zack/20260822-vti-02/hera_scratch/spot67.png", dpi=110)
print("saved spot67.png")

# Tetralayer FS-count forward model — ABAB vs ABCA (vs ABCB)

Backs the `recipes/investigations/tetralayer-stacking-fs-count.md` investigation.
This model computes the **B = 0 Fermi-surface count**, the **Onsager
frequencies F(n)** (and vs interlayer potential u_D for ABCA), and the
**cyclotron masses m\*(n)** the FS-count read overlays on data — ABAB a pair
partitioning F_L (≈ 0.72 / 0.28 with φ²-split masses in the decomposition
limit; the key table below carries the real F(n)) vs ABCA's single
post-cascade pocket at F_L, with ABCB a qualitative cubic + Dirac pair.
**Both carrier signs**: the sign of the input density selects electron
(n > 0) or hole (n < 0) doping.

The survey that grounds it (band structure, the four ingested papers, the
feasibility framing) is `docs/tetralayer-stacking-extraction-survey.md`; read
it for the physics. This README covers what the tools are and how to run them.

## Files

| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `synth_fan.py` | Synthetic Rxx(n, B) fan generator on the model's F(n)/m\*(n): LK thermal + Dingle dressing, 2nd harmonics, background, noise; optional lever-arm scale error, breakdown sum-tone, mixed-domain superposition. Ground truth per column in `truth.json`. |
| `synth_eval.py` | Mechanical recipe evaluator over the synthetic fans (pipeline FFT → Luttinger-aware harmonic screen → global scale pin → template match → B-window split → adjacent-N). Six-case suite + `RESULTS.md` in `$HERA_DATA/tetralayer-synth-validation/`. |
| `JULIA_CROSSCHECK.md` | Independent-implementation eigenvalue comparison (machine precision; see Validation). |
| `fs_count_b0.py` | B = 0 FS count + Onsager F(n) + m\*(n), both carrier signs. **ABAB** from the 2N-band SWMcC Hamiltonian (Koshino–McCann PRB 83, 165443 Eq. 1, N = 4), graphite parameters, via a rotationally-symmetric signed-density radial solve (electron pockets +k²/π, hole pockets −k²/π; the two bilayer-like blocks emerge automatically). **ABCA** from the 8-band continuum model of arXiv 2606.05356 S15 (Eqs. 8–14), parameter Set 1, on a 2D k-grid (trigonal warping → the low-density three-pocket → annulus → single Lifshitz cascade); interlayer potential u_D via the onsite U_l structure. **ABCB** qualitative, via the generic linkage builder. A generic `build_h(kx, ky, seq, p, ud)` dispatches any stacking string ('ABAB','ABCA','ABA','ABC',…) to a Bernal / rhombohedral / mixed block builder by link sense, so trilayer sequences run for backtests. Counts distinct extremal-orbit frequencies F = (ℏ/2πe)·A_k, positive/area-based for electron- and hole-like orbits alike. Pure numpy/scipy; `selftest()`/`__main__` runs every validation gate and prints the key tables. |

## API (call shapes)

- `abab_fs(n, ud=0.0) -> (E_F, [(F, kF), ...])` — every ABAB Onsager orbit at
  E_F, sorted by F.
- `abab_mstar(n, ud=0.0) -> [(F, m*/m_e), ...]` — per-orbit cyclotron masses,
  m\* = ℏ²k_F/|dE/dk|, same orbits/order as `abab_fs`.
- `abca_fs(n, ud=0.0) -> (E_F, topo, n_components, n_freq, F_total)` — topology
  from connected components of the Fermi sea (single / annulus / k-pocket).
- `abca_mstar(n, ud=0.0) -> (F_total, m*/m_e)` — from dn/dE_F on the same solve;
  pocket-summed in the cascade region.
- `abcb_fs(n, ud=0.0) -> (E_F, [(F, ncomp), ...])` — **qualitative**, electron
  side only: the two low-energy conduction tones (cubic J = 3 + Dirac J = 1).
- Generic underneath: `bernal_fs`/`bernal_mstar`/`rhombo_fs`/`rhombo_mstar`
  take a sequence + `Params`; `build_h(kx, ky, seq, p, ud)` returns the
  Hamiltonian; `ABAB`, `ABCA`, `ABA_TRI` are the parameter sets.

Masses are positive for electron- and hole-like orbits alike; the carrier sign
comes from the input n.

## Domain — loud, never clamped

The solvers raise `ValueError` (naming the covered range) for any density
outside the solved table; E_F rows whose Fermi contour would cross the k-grid
edge are excluded from the table on both sides. Solved coverage at u_D = 0:
ABAB ≈ −17.7…+17.1 ×10¹² cm⁻², ABCA ≈ ±11.5 ×10¹² cm⁻² — comfortably beyond
the ±8×10¹² cm⁻² design target.

## Parameters and validity

**Semi-quantitative — trust topology, shape, and partition, not absolute
frequencies.** The discriminating outputs are the FS count, the ABAB partition
and its φ²-split masses, and the model-independent Luttinger sum
Σ±f = (h/4e)|n|. Absolute frequencies inherit the hopping-parameter error bars.

- **ABAB**: Koshino–McCann graphite SWMcC set {γ₀ = 3.0, γ₁ = 0.4, γ₂ = −0.02,
  γ₄ = 0.04, γ₅ = 0.04, Δ′ = 0.05 eV}, all remote couplings ON. **γ₃ = 0**:
  the BL-contour trigonal warping is neglected so the solve stays radial (same
  precedent and caveat as the trilayer ABA treatment — γ₃ touches only the
  low-|n| BL fine structure). The 0.724 / 0.276 partition and φ² ≈ 2.618 mass
  ratio are the **low-n parabolic (decomposition) asymptote**; two effects
  distort them away from it — non-parabolicity (the bilayer bands bend toward
  linear) pulls the ratio *down* with rising |n|, while the γ₂-scale
  band-bottom offset dominates at low |n| and washes out with rising |n|. In
  the full model the electron-side partition passes through ≈ 0.73 near
  |n| ≈ 6×10¹²; the hole side runs lower (≈ 0.64) from the Δ′/γ₄ e–h asymmetry
  and the near-CNP semimetal overlap (§ below). Even-N has no mirror plane, so
  the two bilayer blocks are mixed by γ₂/γ₅ at the ~20 meV scale and inter-block
  magnetic breakdown is symmetry-allowed — the two-FS picture is exact only
  above that scale.
- **ABCA**: arXiv 2606.05356 S15 Set 1 {γ₀ = 3.1, γ₁ = 0.38, γ₂ = −0.015,
  γ₃ = 0.29, γ₄ = 0.141, δ = 0.0105, Δ₂ = 0.002 eV}, **γ₃ ON** (trigonal
  warping is the physics of the low-density cascade, not fine structure).
  u_D enters as a linear interlayer potential V_l = l·u_D (no Hartree screening).
  At operating density (|n| ≳ 2×10¹²) the pocket is single and F(n) is
  Luttinger-solid ((h/4e)|n| by area conservation), insensitive to the
  parameter error bars.
- **ABCB**: qualitative only, via the mixed-linkage builder run on the ABCA
  hopping magnitudes. Reproduces the J = 3 cubic main band + J = 1 Dirac-like
  partner rising from the ~δ (≈ 10 meV) gap; the two tones Luttinger-sum to
  F_L. **Absolute frequencies and the partition are not calibrated** — trust
  the two-tone topology and order of magnitude only. Not gated.
- ABAB is semimetallic near the CNP: for small |n| tiny electron and hole
  pockets coexist (the two blocks' band bottoms are offset at the γ₂ scale),
  the orbit list reports all of them, and only the **signed** sum of
  frequencies equals (h/4e)|n| there.

"""Run 6/7 careful FFT + onset read, restricted to the properly-sampled grid.

Run 6 grid: 50 mT below 1 T, 10 mT above. Below ~0.9 T the 50 mT leg
undersamples any tone above ~F_L/4, so tone claims there are alias-prone.
Restrict the frequency read to B >= 1.0 T (uniform 10 mT).
Run 7 grid: uniform 20 mT over 0.3-10 T -> Nyquist F = B^2/(2*dB):
at B = 1 T -> 25 T; at 0.5 T -> 6.25 T.
"""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import hera.analysis as A
from hera.analysis import open_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, resolve_channels, current_channel

BASE = "/home/hera/measurements/zack/20260822-vti-02/data"
h, e = 6.62607015e-34, 1.602176634e-19
FL = lambda n_cm2: h / (4 * e) * abs(n_cm2) * 1e4


def load(fid):
    run = open_run(f"{BASE}/{fid}")
    ch = resolve_channels(run.meta)
    cur = current_channel(ch)
    c1 = [c for c in ch if c.cid == "sr1"][0]
    B = run.col("magnet_field")
    I = run.col(cur.col) / cur.gain
    R = (run.col(c1.col) / c1.gain) / I
    o = np.argsort(B)
    return B[o], R[o]


def nyq_f(B, dB):
    """Max unaliased frequency for a uniform-B grid at field B."""
    return B ** 2 / (2 * dB)


def peaks(f, s, fmin=2.0, fmax=60.0, nkeep=8):
    m = (f >= fmin) & (f <= fmax)
    ff, ss = f[m], s[m]
    out = []
    for i in range(1, len(ff) - 1):
        if ss[i] > ss[i - 1] and ss[i] >= ss[i + 1]:
            # parabolic refine
            d = ss[i - 1] - 2 * ss[i] + ss[i + 1]
            dx = 0.5 * (ss[i - 1] - ss[i + 1]) / d if d != 0 else 0.0
            out.append((ff[i] + dx * (ff[1] - ff[0]), ss[i]))
    out.sort(key=lambda t: -t[1])
    return out[:nkeep]


print("#" * 78)
print("# RUN 6 — electron, n = +3.20e12 cm^-2, F_L = %.2f T" % FL(3.2e12))
print("#" * 78)
B6, R6 = load(6)
print("grid: dB below 1 T = %.3f T; above = %.3f T"
      % (np.median(np.diff(B6[B6 < 1.0])), np.median(np.diff(B6[B6 > 1.0]))))
for b in (0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0):
    dB = 0.05 if b < 1.0 else 0.01
    print(f"   alias-free up to F = {nyq_f(b, dB):6.1f} T at B = {b} T (dB {dB})")

97-  `fast_param` over `fast_v`. `slow_delay` waits once per slow row (at the first
98-  fast point), `fast_delay` waits at every point.

100-  `slow_params`/`slow_v_list` and `fast_params`/`fast_v_list` are parallel

print(f"   dF = 1/(1/B_lo - 1/B_hi) = {1/span:.2f} T")

GATE_STEP = 5e-3           # V, Keithley volt.step
GATE_WRITE = 6e-3          # s per step (rig card)

B_LO, B_HI = 1.0, 10.0

SLOW_DELAY = 3.0           # 10 tau after the row-start gate flyback

print(" n     F_L    ABAB light  ABAB heavy  ratio   ABCA    f_hv/F_L")
for n in np.arange(N_MIN, N_MAX + 1e-9, 0.2):
    Ef, orbs = M.abab_fs(n * 1e16)
    f1, f2 = sorted(f for f, k in orbs)
    Fa, ma = M.abca_mstar(n * 1e16)
    print(f"{n:+4.1f} {FL(n):7.2f}  {f1:8.2f}  {f2:9.2f}  {f2/f1:6.2f}  {Fa:7.2f}  {f2/FL(n):6.3f}")

FLmax = FL(N_MAX)
print(f"\nF_L(n_max) = {FLmax:.2f} T")

for sens in (20e-6, 50e-6):

# ---- B-window split halves ------------------------------------------------

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`), electron side, D = 0, n = +2.0…+3.2×10¹², B 0.7 → 10 T

**Why this fan, and what it decides.** Run 6 (electron spot check, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.09 T) is the sharpest thing on disk. Read on its properly-sampled leg only — B ≥ 1.0 T, uniform 10 mT; the 50 mT leg below 1 T aliases anything above ~6 T and cannot carry a tone claim — it gives a stable two-fundamental set across every cutoff (1.0–2.5 T) and detrend order (bg 3/5/7): **f₁ ≈ 7.3 T (0.22 F_L, snr 96)** and **f₂ ≈ 29.5 T (0.89 F_L, snr 116)**, with 14.8 / 22.3 / 58.6 / 88.4 T as the comb around them. Two readings survive:

- **ABAB pair** — 7.3 + 29.5 = 36.8 T = 1.11·F_L, i.e. a pair closing the Luttinger sum under one global density rescale s = 1.11 (inside the 0.8–1.2 lever-arm band), partition 0.20/0.80 against the model's 0.22/0.78 at this density (model F(n): 7.31 / 25.78 T — the **light tone lands on the model to 1%**).
- **ABCA singleton** — 29.5 T is the single pocket at s = 0.89·F_L, and 7.3 T is then unexplained; or the mirror-image confound, 29.5 ≈ 4 × 7.35 is simply the **4th harmonic** of a 7.3 T fundamental (58.6 ≈ 2×29.4 and 88.4 ≈ 3×29.4 also fit a harmonic ladder on 29.4).

One density cannot separate these — every one of them is a linear-in-n statement. **The n-dependence does**, and that is exactly what this fan buys (investigation Steps 4–5 + the Luttinger-aware harmonic screen): over n = 2.0 → 3.2×10¹² the model's ABAB ratio f₂/f₁ sweeps **4.82 → 3.53**, crossing 4.00 near n = 2.5×10¹²; a genuine harmonic sits at exactly 4.00 at every density; an ABCA singleton tracks 1.00·F_L flat while ABAB's dominant tone drifts 0.828 → 0.779·F_L. Three separable trajectories, one 37-column fan.

**Side.** Electron, and the trade is stated: the **hole** side is the cleaner one by onset (run 7: tones censored-alive at 0.50 T, snr 127, and visibly clean oscillations from ~0.6 T, against ≥ 1.0 T on the electron side), but the D = 0 line only reaches n = −1.27×10¹² there (TG −0.3 V limit) — the whole hole side lies inside the investigation's documented near-CNP exception regime, where the ABAB pair is close and balanced (model: 5.86 / 6.54 T at −1.2×10¹²) and cannot carry the primary call. Only the electron side reaches the |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² window where the templates separate. Run 7 stays on disk as corroboration, not as the fan.

**Grid — both Nyquist checks, computed.** Δ(1/B) = **7.464×10⁻³ T⁻¹** → f_Nyq = 67.0 T = **2.03 F_L**, deliberately finer than the recipe's 1/(2F_L) = 1.51×10⁻² and 1/(3F_L) = 1.01×10⁻² floors: run 6 carries *real* harmonic content of the 29.4 T tone out to 3f ≈ 88 T (snr 52), and at f_Nyq = 2 F_L its 2f (58.8 T) stays in band while 3f aliases to 45 T — clear of every fundamental. At f_Nyq = F_L the 58.6 T tone would fold onto 7.4 T, i.e. straight onto the tone that decides this. **N_B = 179 rows**, B 0.700 → 10.000 T, uniform in 1/B. n-axis: LL ray spacing at B_lo is Δn = 0.0677×10¹², floor 0.0339 → **N_n = 37** at Δn = 0.0333×10¹² (2.03 pts/ray — the floor, not a choice). Record resolution **δF = 1/(1/B_lo − 1/B_hi) = 0.75 T**, against a 7.3 T tone separation of the ABAB-vs-ABCA dominant-tone gap (25.8 vs 33.1 T) — 10 δF.

**B_lo = 0.7 T, and the bet in it.** Run 6's clean-grid `sdh_onset` returns `onset_b = 1.00 T`, **censored at the record edge** — a lower bound, not a measured die-off — so the recipe's B_lo contract permits going below it. Run 7 pins this device's onset at ≤ 0.50 T at |n| = 1.2×10¹², and the ABAB light pocket is the lightest thing in the model (m* = 0.027 mₑ vs 0.061 heavy), so it is the tone expected to survive lowest. 0.7 T buys the partner tone ≥ 5 periods down to n = 2.2×10¹² (9.7 periods at n = 3.2); at B_lo = 1.0 the partner would only clear 5 periods above n = 2.8×10¹², shrinking the ratio trajectory from a 27% swing to 7% and gutting the read. If the first rows show no content at 0.7–0.9 T the low rows are background and the per-column FFT windows above the fan's own measured onset — recoverable, unlike clipping.

**Sensitivity, fixed for the whole fan: sr1 50 µV** (5 kΩ FS at 10 nA), inherited from both spot checks. Worst corner is n_min × B_max: R(n = 2.0×10¹², 0 T) ≈ 83 Ω by 1/n from run 6, × ~12 MR → ≈ 1 kΩ = **20 % FS**. 20 µV would put that corner at 50 % on a soft MR estimate; saturation is the asymmetric failure (a railed column is flat-topped and unrecoverable by any B-window), so take the headroom. τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB unchanged; `fast_delay = 1.8 s = 6τ` — the per-column-SdH-FFT setting, where the fast-axis lag distorts the extracted signal; `slow_delay = 3.0 s = 10τ` covers the row-start gate flyback.

**Price — from this session's own timing, not inherited constants.** Per-point 1.90 s (run 5 measured 1.098 s/pt at `fast_delay = 1.0` on the same fp set → 0.098 s read overhead; + 1.8 s dwell). Row fixed cost 6.95 s (3 s magnet settle, run-6-calibrated, + 0.95 s gate flyback at 5 mV/6 ms + 3 s slow_delay). Traverse 9.3 T ÷ 0.137 T/min = 67.9 min, and the per-row ramps sum to exactly that. 179 × 37 = **6623 points → 4.97 h**; the headline is **≈ 5 h 30 m** after the session's 5–10 % overrun margin. Ends at **10 T with gates parked at 0** — set up for the LK mass split (Verify) to ride the magnet back down.

**Checkpoints** (both armed on `hera-watch data --next --follow`): **first rows**, B 0.70–0.75 T — oscillation content present at all, no rail, |I_tg|/|I_bg| at the run-6/7 level (≤ 250 pA flyback transients, 1 nA trip), sr1 not flat, T at base; abort in the first two minutes if the channel is dead or railed. **Periodic** — at row ~89 (B ≈ 1.31 T, the 1/B midpoint) a partial per-column FFT on the landed rows (δF ≈ 1.5 T there, enough to see whether the 7.3 T and ~29 T tones are both alive and how they move with n), and again near 3 T. Continue / adjust / abandon called there.

      f"-> f_Nyq {1/(2*_dinv):.1f} T = {1/(2*_dinv)/_FL:.2f} F_L(n_max={n_hi}e12, F_L={_FL:.2f} T)")
print(f"   row dB: min {np.min(np.diff(B_vec))*1e3:.1f} mT, max {np.max(np.diff(B_vec)):.3f} T; "
      f"dF = {1/(1/B_LO - 1/B_HI):.2f} T")

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.8, 3.0   # 6 tau (per-column SdH-FFT fan) / 10 tau over the row-start flyback
I_TRIP = 1e-9

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: starts from the handoff 0 T), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange mid-row), inherited from the spot checks:
# 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA. Worst corner n_min x B_max ~ 1 kOhm = 20 % FS.
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V ({sr1.sensitivity()/10e-9:.0f} Ohm FS at 10 nA), "
      f"tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct -> fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s "
      f"= {FAST_DELAY/sr1.time_constant():.0f} tau; sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan electron side: D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm, n = {ns[0]:+.2f} to {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 "
                  f"({N_n} pts), B = {B_vec[0]:.3f} to {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T ({N_B} rows, uniform 1/B, "
                  f"d(1/B) = {_dinv:.6f}), sr1 50 uV, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm, n = {ns[0]:+.2f} to {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 ({N_n} pts, dn {_dn:.4f}e12), '
              f'B = {B_vec[0]:.3f} to {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T ({N_B} rows, uniform in 1/B, d(1/B) = {_dinv:.6f} 1/T, '
              f'f_Nyq {1/(2*_dinv):.1f} T = 2.03 F_L, dF {1/(1/B_LO - 1/B_HI):.2f} T); '
              f'Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vbgs[-1]:+.4f}; Vsi = 0; '
              f'sr1 sens 50 uV, tau 0.3 s/24 dB, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s (6 tau), slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s; '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, '
              f'D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; per-column SdH-FFT fan for tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4')

# Position: gates to the row start, then the magnet to B_lo (blocking, ~5 min from 0 T).
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)
magnet.field(B_vec[0])
print(f"positioned: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot('time', T_sample); s.plot('time', sr1.P)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
# Field deliberately left at 10 T: the LK mass split (Verify) rides it back down.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), "
      f"T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
